description: Mark a thread resolved (it leaves the canvas but stays in the document), or reopen it with resolved: false. Takes no undo step.

documentId.description: File-mode document id from openflow_open or openflow_create; omit to use the paired editor (or, in file mode, the document opened or created last).

pageId.description: Page to act on (see list_pages); defaults to the page the editor shows, or the first page in file mode. A repo map page is read from the code: a change for it lands on the map's drawing, which the editor shows.

name: resolve_thread
title: Resolve a thread
